## Final discounted tariffs
- Hall Dormitory: ₹299 per bed / night
- 4-Bed Dormitory: ₹350 per bed / night
- 8-Bed Mixed Dormitory: ₹399 per bed / night
- 1BHK Cooler Room: ₹999 per room / night
- 1BHK AC Room: ₹1,500 per room / night
- 2BHK Entire Room: ₹2,999 per night for up to 5 guests; ₹3,500 per night for 6–8 guests (maximum 8); directly bookable when both 1BHK rooms are vacant for all requested nights

## Important booking note
Regular website bookings check the website inventory and place a short payment hold. The full listed stay amount is due online; the website confirms the booking only after the payment provider verifies payment. Domestic checkout appears once Awara's approved Indian provider is connected. International checkout uses PayPal in USD. The 2BHK is directly bookable only when both 1BHK rooms are vacant for every requested night. Staff record offline and OTA bookings manually in the staff booking desk; OTA calendars are not automatically connected. Contact Awara directly for cancellation or refund requests. PayPal.Me (https://paypal.me/awara888) remains a manual international-payment fallback and does not confirm a website booking.

The private staff desk is at https://awarahostels.com/staff.html and requires staff sign-in. It is intended for staff to adjust website capacity, record offline/OTA bookings, review site bookings and review online bookings.
